steps: Peel and core the pear and chop it into small pieces.
Dry roast the oats in a small pan on low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until they smell toasty.
Add the pear and about 100 ml water to the oats.
Cook on low heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pear is soft.
Pour in the milk and simmer for one more minute.
Mash the pear with the back of the spoon and stir in the cinnamon.
Let it cool until just warm before serving.
note: A pinch of cinnamon stands in for the cloves and dates one source uses, so there is no added sweetness. Pears ripen fast, so use a soft one.
